description: Find files by name pattern under a folder. * matches within one folder level, ** matches any number of levels, ? one character; a pattern without / matches the file name at any depth ("*.py" finds every .py file). Prints one path per line (folders end with /), sorted by path ("sort": "mtime" = newest first); paste a path into read, view or ls. Skips names starting with . unless "hidden": true and, inside a git work tree, paths ignored by .gitignore unless "gitignore": false. At most max_items per call; a last line "... next_offset N" means more. To search inside files, use grep. Errors: PatternBad, FileMissing, FileBad.

pattern.description: the name pattern, relative to path (e.g. *.py, src/**/*.json, docs/*)

path.description: the folder to search under, relative to your workspace or absolute (default .)

type.description: what to list: file, dir or any (default file)

sort.description: name = by path (default); mtime = newest first

hidden.description: true = also look into names starting with .

gitignore.description: false = also list paths that .gitignore ignores

max_items.description: most paths to show (default 100, at most 500)
